title: Soldier
html:
Soldier is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around war and masterful combat. Lae'zel, Jaheira, and the hireling Varanna Sunblossom have this background.

“
You are trained in battlefield tactics and combat, having served in a militia, mercenary company, or officer corps. Show smart tactics and bravery on the battlefield to enhance your prowess.
„

Background features

  • Athletics Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Strength (Athletics) Ability Checks.
  • Intimidation Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Charisma (Intimidation) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
General
Anywhere 25 One For The Ages Survive a fight in which you kill ten or more enemies.
  • Summoned creatures that disappear when their summoner dies count toward this.
25 Pentacrush Kill 5 enemies in a single turn.
25 Strategist Defeat a powerful foe in one strike.
Act 1
Emerald Grove 20 No One Left Behind Ensure all of the Grove's defenders survive the first goblin assault.
  •  Aradin,  Barth, and  Remira must survive the initial fight at the ramparts
  • Kanon dying in the prior cutscene does not prevent getting this.
20 To Arms! Help Guex learn to fight.
  • The interacting party member must succeed an Athletics or an Insight check, or use any available Class-based/Race-based options.
  • The Soldier character is not necessary the one to pass the checks
Goblin Camp 25 A Headless Horde Kill every leader in the goblin camp.
  • Dror Ragzlin, Gut, and Minthara are the relevant leaders.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Slaughter's Prize and ⁠Guardian of the Forgotten inspirations.
Mountain Pass 30 Conquer the Conquerors Defeat the Githyanki raiding squad.
  • Requires actually fighting them; a peaceful resolution does not grant inspiration.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Silver Blades, Silver Tongue inspiration.
Risen Road 30 Chain of Command Follow Flaming Fist orders at the burning inn. This is earned after knocking down the door.
30 Warrior of the Hells Kill the cultist leader seeking Karlach.
Underdark 30 Drowned in the Dark Defeat the duergar patrolling on the Ebonlake.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Know Thine Enemy Defeat yourself in the Gauntlet of Shar's mirror trial.
  • Shared with ⁠Self-Flagellation inspiration.
75 Return to Sender Kill the orthon, returning him to Raphael.
75 Soldier of Faith Save and release Nightsong.
  • Shared with ⁠Cerimonia Alārum, ⁠Damsel No More, ⁠Soldier of Fortune, and ⁠Good Deed of the Day inspirations.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Blood Moon, ⁠Cerimonia Compedum, and ⁠Soldier of Fortune inspirations.
75 Soldier of Fortune Give Nightsong to Ketheric.
  • Allow Balthazar to transport Nightsong from the Shadowfell.
  • Shared with ⁠Cerimonia Compedum inspiration.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Blood Moon, ⁠Cerimonia Alārum, ⁠Damsel No More, ⁠Soldier of Faith, and ⁠Good Deed of the Day inspirations.
Last Light Inn 75 Absolute Devastation Destroy Last Light.
  • The party must remove the lunar protective shield around the Last Light Inn, either killing or knocking out Isobel.
50 Shield of the Moon Obtain Selûne's blessing from Isobel.
Moonrise Towers 95 A Bone To Pick Overcome the skeletons in Moonrise prison during the assault.
75 Devastation of the Absolute Complete the assault on Moonrise.
50 Notched Armour Show off your prowess to the bugbear merchant.
  • Shared with ⁠Uncommon Recognition inspiration.
Reithwin Town 60 An Apple a Day Keeps the Scalpel Away Defeat the Surgeon without being operated upon.
  • Shared with ⁠Under the Knife inspiration. Also shared with ⁠The Best Offence is Virtually Nonsense, if that one was not obtained earlier.
60 Familicide Kill all members of the Thorm family.
  • This includes only Gerringothe, Malus, and Thisobald.
  • Shared with ⁠Power Corrupts... Absolutely inspiration.
60 The Best Offence is Virtually Nonsense Defeat a member of the Thorm family without drawing steel.
  • Gerringothe, Malus, and Thisobald can each be eliminated via a series of skill checks.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Centennial Rivalries Complete the Harper ambush.
75 Masterful Execution Kill any of the bosses in and around the Shadow-Cursed Lands in a single round of combat.
50 Realities of War Tell Arabella what happened to her parents.
Act 3
Bhaal Temple 220 Putting the Past to Rest Execute Orin.
  • Shared with ⁠Securing Your Line inspiration.
House of Hope 220 Hot Exit Escape the House of Hope.
  • Shared with ⁠Interplanar Cat Burglar inspiration.
Lower City 220 Double-Tap Kill Auntie Ethel... again...
  • Shared with ⁠Re-tasting the Kill and ⁠Estrangement of Ethel inspirations.
170 Innovations in Volatility Give your blood to Araj a second time.
220 Kicking the Rust Bucket Destroy a Steel Watcher.
  • Shared with ⁠Down with the Steel Oppressors! inspiration.
220 Knives in the Dark Survive the confrontation in the Sharran Cloister.
135 Love That Smell Aid the deep gnomes and use the Runepowder Bomb to blow up the Steel Watch Foundry.
  • Shared with ⁠A Foul and Awesome Display and ⁠A Massacre Beyond Imagining inspirations.
170 Urgent Communications Commune with the Netherbrain.
  • Talk to Edenosa after the ambush in the park.
  • If Edenosa was killed in the fight, talking to Fist Griff (a replacement NPC) instead does not give the inspiration.
170 Veteran's Hotspot Purchase a room at the Elfsong Tavern.

Shared with ⁠Proper Lodging, Finally⁠, ⁠For Once, a Warm Meal, and ⁠Perks of the Trade inspirations (the latter if a discount was gained).

Rivington 135 Removing Chaotic Actors Remove the head of the deep gnome insurrectionists.
  • This requires saving Wulbren from Moonrise Towers, but then killing him as part of Deal with the Gnomes.
  • Shared with ⁠Buyable Loyalty inspiration.
135 Reporting for Duty Report to Commander Lightfeather.
  • Shared with ⁠Enlisted Avian inspiration.
135 Sharing the Spoils Donate to the refugees.
  • Shared with ⁠Alms for the Unfortunate, ⁠Sharing the Spoils, ⁠Spare What You Can, ⁠Food for the Soul, and ⁠Gifts of the Wilds inspirations.
Upper City 220 Rudolph Van Richtover My Dead Body Defeat the Ascended Cazador.
  • Obtaining this inspiration means losing  Astarion as a companion permanently, as Cazador sacrifices him to ascend.
Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Court Marshall Expose the Flaming Fist deserter.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Easing His Leave, and His Pockets inspiration.
170 Great Helm of Legends Find the Helm of Balduran.
  • Shared with ⁠Heavy is the Head inspiration.
220 Regicide Execute Gortash.
  • Shared with ⁠Shattering the Black Hand inspiration, and ⁠Never Trust Those Above You (the latter if Gortash was killed without making a deal with him).

Cut Background Goals

  • Start Them Young: Inspire the tiefling children to train harder. The tiefling children are present, but the inspiration event is not implemented anymore and therefore does not trigger.
  • Stalwart Heart: Persuade Rolan to stay and protect the grove. Rolan can be convinced to stay and protect the grove, but the inspiration event is not implemented anymore and therefore does not trigger.
  • War is No Place for a Child: Lie to Arabella about her parents' fate. Arabella can be lied to after the party find her parents, but the trigger for this inspiration event is a specific unreachable scene with Withers and Arabella.
  • Lolth's Last Laugh: Defeat Viconia and her Sharran cohorts. This does not appear to be implemented.
